response.sql: WITH profile_stats AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), compared AS (SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) OVER () AS mean_profile_average FROM profile_stats) SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, avg_bandwidth_usage - mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean FROM compared WHERE mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL
